# Math

*JavaScript*

Math functions and constants, called on `Math` itself: `Math.max(a, b)`. Angles are in radians: `degrees * Math.PI / 180`.

## Methods

### abs {#abs}

::: member

Absolute value.

```js
Math.abs(-5); // 5
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `x` | [`number`](/scripting/js/Number) | number |

**Returns** [`number`](/scripting/js/Number) — the value without its sign

:::

### acos {#acos}

::: member

Arccosine.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `x` | [`number`](/scripting/js/Number) | cosine from -1 to 1 |

**Returns** [`number`](/scripting/js/Number) — angle in radians from 0 to PI, `NaN` outside -1..1

:::

### acosh {#acosh}

::: member

Inverse hyperbolic cosine.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `x` | [`number`](/scripting/js/Number) | number, 1 or more |

**Returns** [`number`](/scripting/js/Number) — the result, `NaN` below 1

:::

### asin {#asin}

::: member

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `x` | [`number`](/scripting/js/Number) | sine from -1 to 1 |

**Returns** [`number`](/scripting/js/Number) — angle in radians from -PI/2 to PI/2, `NaN` outside -1..1

:::

### asinh {#asinh}

::: member

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |

| --- | --- | --- |
| `x` | [`number`](/scripting/js/Number) | tangent |

**Returns** [`number`](/scripting/js/Number) — angle in radians from -PI/2 to PI/2

:::

### atanh {#atanh}

::: member

Inverse hyperbolic tangent.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `x` | [`number`](/scripting/js/Number) | number from -1 to 1 |

**Returns** [`number`](/scripting/js/Number) — the result, `NaN` outside -1..1

:::

### atan2 {#atan2}

::: member

Angle of the point `(x, y)` from the X axis; note that `y` goes first. Handy to turn a direction into a rotation.

```js
const yaw = Math.atan2(dz, dx) * 180 / Math.PI;
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `y` | [`number`](/scripting/js/Number) | Y coordinate |
| `x` | [`number`](/scripting/js/Number) | X coordinate |

**Returns** [`number`](/scripting/js/Number) — angle in radians from -PI to PI

:::

### floor {#floor}

::: member

Rounds down; turns a coordinate into a block coordinate.

```js

```

| --- | --- | --- |
| `x` | [`number`](/scripting/js/Number) | number |

**Returns** [`number`](/scripting/js/Number) — the largest integer not greater than `x`

:::

:::

### hypot {#hypot}

::: member

| --- | --- | --- |
| `values` | [`number`](/scripting/js/Number) | one or more numbers |

**Returns** [`number`](/scripting/js/Number) — the length

:::

### max {#max}

::: member

The largest of the numbers. For an array: `Math.max.apply(null, list)`.

```js
Math.max(1, 5, 3); // 5
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `values` | [`number`](/scripting/js/Number) | numbers to compare |

**Returns** [`number`](/scripting/js/Number) — the largest number, `-Infinity` without arguments

:::

### min {#min}

::: member

The smallest of the numbers.

```js
Math.min(hp + 4, 20); // heal, but not above 20
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `values` | [`number`](/scripting/js/Number) | numbers to compare |

**Returns** [`number`](/scripting/js/Number) — the smallest number, `Infinity` without arguments

:::

### pow {#pow}

::: member

`base` to the power of `exponent`; the `**` operator does the same.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `base` | [`number`](/scripting/js/Number) | base |
| `exponent` | [`number`](/scripting/js/Number) | exponent |

**Returns** [`number`](/scripting/js/Number) — the result

:::

### random {#random}

::: member

Random number from 0 (included) to 1 (excluded).

```js
Math.floor(Math.random() * 6) + 1; // dice: 1 to 6
```

**Returns** [`number`](/scripting/js/Number) — random number in [0, 1)

:::

### round {#round}

::: member


| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `x` | [`number`](/scripting/js/Number) | number |

**Returns** [`number`](/scripting/js/Number) — the rounded integer

:::
